1.w: Better [is] one being poor walking in his integrity than the one crooked [in] his lips, and he [is] a fool.

2.w: Also, a soul without knowledge [is] not good; and the one hurrying with [his] feet is sinning.

3.w: The folly of a man perverts his way, and his heart rages against YHWH.

4.w: Wealth adds many friends, and a poor one is separated from his friend.

5.w: A witness of falsehoods will not be acquitted, and the one breathing out lies will not escape.

6.w: Many will entreat the face of a noble, and everyone [is] the friend to a man of gift.

7.w: All the brothers of a poor one hate him; surely also his friends are far from him! He pursues with words—they are nowhere.

8.w: The one acquiring heart is loving his soul; the one guarding understanding will find good.

9.w: A witness of falsehoods will not be acquitted, and the one breathing out lies will perish.

10.w: Luxury [is] not fitting for a fool—even less for a slave to rule over princes.

11.w: The discretion of a man makes long his nose, and his splendor is to pass over a transgression.

12.w: The rage of a king [is] like the roaring of the young lion, and his favor [is] like dew on the grass.

13.w: A foolish son [is] the ruin of his father, and the quarrels of a wife [are] a continual dripping.

14.w: A house and wealth [are] the inheritance of fathers, and from YHWH [is] a wife [who] is prudent.

15.w: Sluggishness causes a deep sleep to fall, and a soul of slackness will be hungry.

16.w: One guarding a commandment is guarding his soul; one despising His ways will die.

17.w: The one showing favor [to] the poor [is] lending [to] YHWH, and his dealing He will repay to him.

18.w: Discipline your son, for there is hope, and do not lift up your soul toward putting him to death.

19.w: One harsh of anger lifts up the penalty; indeed, if you deliver [him], you will add yet again.

20.w: Listen to counsel and receive discipline, so that you may be wise in your latter end.

21.w: Many plans [are] in the heart of a man, and the counsel of YHWH, it will stand.

22.w: The desire of a man is loving devotion, and one being poor [is] better than a man of lies.

23.w: The fear of YHWH [is] to life, and satisfied he will abide; he will not be visited [by] evil.

24.w: A lazy one hides his hand in the dish; even to his mouth he will not bring it back.

25.w: Strike a mocker and a simple one acts prudently; and rebuke a discerning one—he will discern knowledge.

26.w: One assaulting a father causes a mother to flee; [he is] a son causing shame and bringing reproach.

27.w: Cease, my son, to hear instruction—you will stray from the words of knowledge.

28.w: A witness of worthlessness scorns justice, and the mouth of wicked ones swallows iniquity.

29.w: Judgments are prepared for the mockers, and beatings for the back of fools.
